verdict.rationale: Kintsugi markets finding exposure, registering, and filing (kintsugi-docs-15) and can backfill historical transaction data via CSV upload (kintsugi-docs-22) plus create registrations across jurisdictions (kintsugi-docs-12, kintsugi-docs-23), which addresses part of the remediation need. However, there is no explicit mention of voluntary disclosure agreements (VDAs) or a formal back-filing/catch-up program for past tax liabilities — only forward-looking nexus determination and registration/filing APIs. Missing for 10: explicit VDA program details, back-filing of historical tax periods/liabilities, and any documentation of negotiating reduced-lookback settlements with states.
